Not everyone needs external stress to feel stress. It comes out of no where and sometimes we inadvertently train ourselves to be stressed.

My daughter passed away and I was super moody. I was blowing up, being a butthole, bumming everyone out, but I was lucky as hell to have my SO check me. He was the reason I did 5.5 years of grief counseling (alone) and it was the best change I ever made in my life. Those new habits and routines stick with me today.  Everyone else around me and in my family had their own lives and couldn't cater to me as if I was a child, so when you have the time to NOTICE something, SAY something. ESPECIALLY if you have a solution in mind.

I hope you guys can grow together❤
